---
title: "Glossary"
---

## Actuator

A physical device that produces motion. In this course, the Dynamixel AX-12A
rotates the lamp head. Referenced as an abstraction, not a register bank.

## Capability

A semantic operation a consumer can request (for example `nod`), independent of
how it is realized. Consumers request capabilities; implementations choose the
realization.

## Digital twin

A Pico-based representation of the logical actuator and its state — distinct
from merely mirroring a hardware register. Holds **desired state** and
**observed state**.

## Desired state

What the system has been asked to be (for example `desiredPosition`).

## Observed state

What the system reports it currently is (for example `actualPosition`).

## Edge adapter

Hardware/software that sits at the boundary between Open Engineering semantics
and a device protocol. The ESP32 is the edge adapter in this course: it speaks
actuator-level commands to the AX-12A and never character meaning.

## Home Assistant

A home automation platform used here strictly as a **human control surface**.
It requests capabilities (`nod`, `center`, `stop`); it does not own the
actuator behavior or implement a servo trajectory.

## Control surface

The Open Engineering term for an interface that lets a human (or another actor)
express intent, without becoming the runtime or the ontology owner.

## Pico

The Open Engineering abstraction for a declarative, composable digital entity
described by Rules and produced by a Parser and a Composer. In this course a
Pico represents the logical head-pitch actuator.

## Manifold

The Pico runtime execution environment: a Kubernetes-hosted `RuntimeEnvironment`
that hosts a Pico Element and executes its rules when events arrive.

## Crossplane

Declarative composition for the control plane. In this course it composes the
resources needed to realize the requested actuator capability — *what should
exist*.

## Open Engineering event

A semantic message that represents something happening in the system, carried
below the semantic layer by a transport (for example MQTT). A nod request
becomes an event such as `pixstars.head.nod.requested`.

## Correlation identifier

A unique identifier attached to every request so one `nod` can be followed
through Home Assistant → event → Pico → rule → command → edge → servo →
completion → telemetry.

## Nod

The first, mandatory gesture. A deterministic motion sequence: center → slightly
down → slightly up → return to center. Exact safe servo positions are
configurable and calibrated, never hard-coded into generic definitions.

## Simulation-before-physics

The principle that every capability should be testable without hardware. The
`SimulatedActuator` and `DynamixelAX12AActuator` implement the same contract.

## Safe limits

Configurable minimum/maximum positions, movement speed, timeout, emergency
stop, and safe startup/shutdown states within which all physical movement must
operate.
